snippet.title: Moonshiner Garage
snippet.description:
Welcome to Moonshiner Garage — real builds, real people, and real horsepower! We’re a Texas-based automotive channel focused on drag racing, high-performance builds, repairs, tools, fabrication, troubleshooting, and the hot rod lifestyle.

Follow Thomas and the ’87 Chevy Squarebody “Moonshiner,” along with father-and-son team Ryan and Jake and their performance projects, including Jake’s Prime Dime S-10. From the garage to the racetrack, we show the wins, failures, and real work behind making horsepower.

Our audience is made up of automotive and motorsports enthusiasts interested in performance parts, tools, shop equipment, trucks, racing products, and DIY repair.

We also promote Tailgate Throwdown, one of the largest trucks-only racing events around.

We welcome partnerships with brands that fit our audience and products we can genuinely use, test, and demonstrate.

snippet.title: Urban Fallout
snippet.description:
Urban Fallout is a practical preparedness channel covering how to get ready for power outages, severe weather, infrastructure disruptions, and other emergencies — with a focus on preparing when you live in a city or urban area. We break down real supply lists, shelter-in-place basics, and practical steps for building a household emergency plan.

These videos are mostly made with AI. The script rough draft is written by me. Then use ChatGPT and Claude to make a better script from that then personally fine tune it to suit me. I use Gemini for some images; I use images and video from sites like Pixabay and Pexels to help put together the story. I use  Elevenlabs for voices. I use Canva to make the videos, no template used.

snippet.title: David Canterbury
snippet.description:
From the lore of Bush Craft and Wood Craft to all things related to self-sustainability and Woodsmanship the Pathfinder vision is to pass on the knowledge of outdoor self-reliance. Providing basic to advanced self-reliance training and survival gear, our goal is to offer both practical knowledge and survival gear that will stand the test of time. From emergency preparedness to sustainability, the Pathfinder way is to share and educate.

Here you can explore the world of survival knives, survival kits and simple tips on outdoor self-reliance. We are always learning and enjoy passing on the knowledge we acquire.  

There is no substitute for having a plan in the event of the unexpected.

VERTEX brings you in-depth analysis, breaking updates, and expert insights on the world’s most critical political and geopolitical developments. From the Ukraine war, Middle East conflicts, and US & UK political dynamics to evolving global alliances and policy shifts, we explore not just what is happening, but why it matters.

Our content features expert explainers that break down complex issues, exclusive interviews with analysts, diplomats, and policy experts. Timely crisis updates and policy breakdowns that reveal the strategies behind the headlines. We also provide geopolitical deep-dives on global conflicts, international relations, and shifting power dynamics. From breaking news to in-depth analysis, Vertex helps you navigate global politics with clarity, context, and perspective.

Subscribe now and hit the bell icon to get daily updates on geopolitics, global affairs, and international news, directly from experts and reliable sources.

snippet.title: Off Grid with Jay and Jen
snippet.description:
Help us reach 100K subscribers in 2026– hit that subscribe button and follow our off-grid journey!
We’re Jay and Jen, two regular folks building a dream — debt-free — on 15 remote, wooded acres in Northern Michigan. From our main cabin to a pole barn, a solar/water system, and mini cabins in the woods, we’ve built it all with our own hands and a whole lot of determination.

We keep it real: honest costs, affordable solar setups, and no fancy tools or drama — just real off-grid living. If we can do it, so can you. Whether you're dreaming of going off-grid or just love simple, self-reliant living, you're in the right place.

New videos twice a week. Come build the dream with us!
💬 Say Hi: Offgridwithjayandjen@yahoo.com
📍 Mail: 1409 W Main Street #149 Gaylord, MI 49735 

#OffGridLife #DIYProjects #SustainableLiving #DebtFreeLiving #WoodStoveHeating

snippet.title: KRAAZ
snippet.description:

Here you’ll find dedicated, hardcore DayZ gameplay, focusing on authentic survival, strategy, and high-stakes encounters:

• Live Streams: Real-time survival runs, intense base building, raids, and tactical PvP action with live voice commentary. • Map Exploration: In-depth runs across classic and new terrains, including Badlands, Nasdara, Chernarus, and Livonia. • Tactics & Guides: Creative trap designs, raiding strategies, and survival mechanics breakdown. • Highlights & Shorts: Quick, engaging clips, hilarious fails, and clutch combat moments.

I primarily play first-person (1PP) hardcore servers, focusing on true atmosphere, quick decision-making, and community interaction during streams.

Hit subscribe, ring the bell, and join the journey on the next live stream!
